title: oxyceros griffithii
intro: Oxyceros griffithii, commonly known as the Red Bignonia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Bignoniaceae. The health benefits of Oxyceros griffithii include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in treating fever, cough, and other respiratory-related conditions, as well as its application in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Oxyceros griffithii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
